messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images (front and back views). Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to video 0 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises both hands to the sides of her head around the middle of the clip, and lowers them back to her sides by the end.","camera":"Static medium-long side profile shot at roughly eye level, with the character centered-left in frame.","clothing":"Bright pink long-sleeve top with a dark patterned panel on the sleeve, a short white pleated skirt, and black lace-up boots.","hair_color":"White or very light blonde, mostly hidden by the hat.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair tucked under a white bucket hat.","identity":"A slender, stylized 3D female character with pale skin, shown in profile facing right.","scene":"An outdoor concrete dock or pier beside calm water, with a weathered concrete wall, rocks, mossy ground, and wooden pilings in the background under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color, since most of the hair is covered by the white bucket hat."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's visible hair remains short, light-colored, and tucked under the white bucket hat in the output, matching the source. No clear new hairstyle structure from the references is visible.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the character's hair to match the reference hairstyle shape and structure, while preserving the original hair color, facial features, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the hidden hair under the bucket hat was restyled, since most of the hair is obscured in both videos.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker and more contrasted than the source, especially in shadows and the sky.
